name: ds-wardrobe
description: DS Wardrobe e-commerce: Medusa v2 backend + Next.js storefront (Turborepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,storefront -c magenta,cyan "npm run backend:dev" "npm run storefront:dev"
scripts.build: turbo build && npm --prefix apps/storefront run build
scripts.lint: turbo lint && npm --prefix apps/storefront run lint
scripts.db: npm --prefix tools/dev-db install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm --prefix tools/dev-db run db
